description: Capabilities for the desktop pet bubble notification window (speech bubble above the pet). All window mutation (show/hide/position) goes through custom `pet_bubble_*` invoke commands which bypass the ACL, so no `core:window:*` perms are needed here. The bubble only needs event access: `listen` for `pet://bubble-show` (render + TTL) and `emit` for `pet://bubble-action` (button/title jump → main window routes).
